faqs.q: What areas in and around Lagos Nigeria do you cover?
faqs.a: We proudly serve all residential and commercial clients across Lagos Nigeria and neighboring metro communities.

faqs.q: How do I receive a quote for my project?
faqs.a: Simply submit your contact information via our online estimate form or call our direct phone line. We will schedule a prompt assessment.

faqs.q: Are your technicians licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes, all technicians and project managers are fully licensed, background-checked, and carry comprehensive liability insurance.

faqs.q: What warranties or guarantees do you offer?
faqs.a: We back our workmanship with clear quality guarantees and provide all manufacturer warranties on installed equipment and materials.
